promises.label: Maintain 18-20% EBITDA margin band for FY27
promises.quote: we believe as we go forward, for the year we should be able to maintain the band of what we have spoken of 18% to 20%
promises.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: VAE facility ramp to full capacity within a year
promises.quote: within a year's time we should be able to ramp up to full capacity offering this GenNext emulsion
promises.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: VAE benefit 300-500 bps on relevant products
promises.quote: when it really works to its full potential, it should really give us some advantage of 300 bps to 500 bps on relevant products
promises.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: Expect 8-9% volume growth going forward
promises.quote: we feel that it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward
promises.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: 3.5% price increase announced for November
promises.quote: We have announced an almost 3.5% price increase for November, which has already been announced
promises.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: Gross margin band 41-43%
promises.quote: This band of about 41% to 43% would really be the band we should be looking forward to
promises.speaker: Amit Syngle

promises.label: International PBT margin to lift in Q3-Q4
promises.quote: as we go ahead and realize the overall price increase benefits, the PBT margin will get lifted into quarter three and quarter four
promises.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.label: Decorative volume growth 6.4%
reported.quote: we have been able to grow at a good volume of about 6.4% at the base of the last year

reported.label: Decorative value growth 14.5%
reported.quote: the value growth has also been very strong at 14.5%

reported.label: H1 volume growth ~8%, value ~16%
reported.quote: the volume growth is pretty strong at about 8% and the value growth being closer to 16%

reported.label: Standalone PBDIT margin 17.1%
reported.quote: PBDIT margin is about 17.1% compared to the last year, same quarter which was about 18.5%

reported.label: Consolidated net sales growth ~17%
reported.quote: the net sales growing at about 17% in quarter two

reported.label: H1 consolidated PBDIT margin 18.2%, PAT +24%
reported.quote: the PBDIT margin which is at about 18.2% in the band what we have spoken of and also the PAT growth being very healthy at about 24%

reported.label: VAE facility commissioned in September
reported.quote: in September we started our VAE facility... out of the total CapEx of about Rs. 3,250 crores
